schemes.title: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship for BC and EBC Students
schemes.department: BC & EBC Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
schemes.description: Direct benefit transfer of post-matric tuition fees and non-refundable mandatory charges for Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class students of Bihar.

schemes.title: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship for SC and ST Students
schemes.department: SC & ST Welfare Department, Government of Bihar
schemes.description: Government of India & Government of Bihar joint scholarship granting comprehensive fee coverage and maintenance to SC/ST students in post-matric studies.

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Medhavriti Yojana for 12th Pass Girl Students (Bihar)
schemes.description: Special state incentive of ₹15,000 to unmarried female students of Bihar who pass the Intermediate examination in first division.
